purpose: Preserve historical observations and their raw samples for later reproduction and comparison; this file is not a verified benchmark manifest.
limitations: Each result contains seven measured samples from one process, after one warmup; the two 0.3.48 batches are independent measurements, not an alternating multi-process verification.
Each sample set mixes the two scroll directions and corresponding activity rows; do not interpret the minimum sample as a historical record.
OS, CPU, runtime, DPI, fonts, theme and renderer were not captured in the original result files; do not infer their historical values from the current environment.
The original results have no captured-at field or complete component manifest; the artifact path and raw data do not prove a complete runtime or application identity.
The 0.3.48 candidate directory was later overwritten. Its exact measured sources and binaries cannot be reconstructed from that directory alone.
These candidates include 0.3.47, which predates the wavy emphasis feature. Preserve its observations while separately explaining the cost and behavior of later functionality.
Each fixture is a separate scenario; the ordinary and dense metrics and results from different measurement windows or window-width sequences must not be mixed.

ordinary.contents: Two headings, three bold spans, one italic span and one prewarmed display formula per answer.

dense.contents: Six headings, thirty bold spans and twelve italic spans per answer.

0.3.47.evidence: The archived baseline application source was compared with this commit: 169 of 170 tracked src text files matched; the sole difference was an empty win-x64 section omitted from the restored TeXeed.Core lock file. Application assets, binaries and the complete environment were not independently verified.
0.3.47.build_note: The benchmark build was passed Version=0.3.48 to match the version number used for the then-current comparison.

0.3.48.evidence: The original measurement was reported as 0.3.48; the candidate source and binary used at the time were later overwritten, so identity with the related commit is not fully verified.
